windows-mcp._warning: Hands the AI your mouse and keyboard: click, type, screenshot, OCR, kill processes. 53 tools. Only enable if you want that.

filesystem._comment: Read/write files under the listed directories only. Requires Node.js.

http-bridge._comment: Generic bridge that turns any HTTP API into MCP tools. Edit the JSON, no code needed. Ships in extras/.
